title: Exercício
description: Duração por tipo de exercício, totais do período e a tabela dos treinos; um exercício conta no dia e na hora em que começa.

targets.rawSql:
with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local,
         now() at time zone '$__timezone' as now_local
),
exercise as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', e.period_start_local) as bucket,
         coalesce(e.exercise_label, 'Sem tipo') as label,
         coalesce(e.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from e.period_end - e.period_start)) as duration_seconds
  from read_model.current_exercise e, period
  where e.period_start_local >= from_local and e.period_start_local < to_local
),
first_data as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', min(period_start_local)) as bucket from read_model.current_exercise
),
buckets as (
  select generate_series(
           greatest(read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', from_local), first_data.bucket),
           read_model.local_bucket('$agrupar', least(to_local, now_local)),
           '1 $agrupar'::interval) as bucket
  from period, first_data
  where first_data.bucket is not null
  union
  select bucket from exercise
),
label as (
  select distinct label from exercise
)
select b.bucket at time zone '$__timezone' as time,
       l.label as metric,
       coalesce(sum(e.duration_seconds), 0) as "Duração"
from buckets b
cross join label l
left join exercise e on e.bucket = b.bucket and e.label = l.label
where b.bucket < (select to_local from period)
group by b.bucket, l.label
order by 1, 2

with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local,
         now() at time zone '$__timezone' as now_local
),
exercise as (
  select coalesce(e.exercise_label, 'Sem tipo') as label,
         coalesce(e.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from e.period_end - e.period_start)) as duration_seconds,
         e.distance_meters,
         e.calories_kilocalories
  from read_model.current_exercise e, period
  where e.period_start_local >= from_local and e.period_start_local < to_local
),
total as (
  select label,
         count(*) as workouts,
         sum(duration_seconds) as duration_seconds,
         sum(distance_meters) as distance_meters,
         sum(calories_kilocalories) as calories_kilocalories,
         sum(distance_meters) filter (where distance_meters > 0 and duration_seconds > 0) as paced_meters,
         sum(duration_seconds) filter (where distance_meters > 0 and duration_seconds > 0) as paced_seconds
  from exercise
  group by label
)
select label as "Tipo",
       workouts as "Treinos",
       duration_seconds as "Duração",
       distance_meters / 1000 as "Distância",
       calories_kilocalories as "Calorias",
       paced.kilometers_per_hour as "Velocidade",
       (paced.seconds_per_km / 60)::text || ':' || lpad((paced.seconds_per_km % 60)::text, 2, '0') || ' /km' as "Ritmo"
from total
left join lateral (
  select paced_meters / paced_seconds * 3.6 as kilometers_per_hour,
         round(paced_seconds * 1000 / paced_meters)::int as seconds_per_km
  where paced_meters > 0 and paced_seconds > 0
) paced on true
order by duration_seconds desc, label

with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local,
         now() at time zone '$__timezone' as now_local
),
exercise as (
  select e.samsung_uid, e.custom_title, e.period_start, e.period_start_local, e.period_end_local,
         coalesce(e.exercise_label, 'Sem tipo') as label,
         coalesce(e.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from e.period_end - e.period_start)) as duration_seconds,
         e.distance_meters,
         e.calories_kilocalories
  from read_model.current_exercise e, period
  where e.period_start_local >= from_local and e.period_start_local < to_local
)
select to_char(period_start_local, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') as "Início",
       label as "Tipo",
       custom_title as "Título",
       duration_seconds as "Duração",
       distance_meters / 1000 as "Distância",
       calories_kilocalories as "Calorias",
       paced.kilometers_per_hour as "Velocidade",
       (paced.seconds_per_km / 60)::text || ':' || lpad((paced.seconds_per_km % 60)::text, 2, '0') || ' /km' as "Ritmo",
       samsung_uid,
       cast(cast(extract(epoch from (period_start_local - interval '5 minutes') at time zone '$__timezone') * 1000 as bigint) as text) as "from",
       cast(cast(extract(epoch from (period_end_local + interval '5 minutes') at time zone '$__timezone') * 1000 as bigint) as text) as "to"
from exercise
left join lateral (
  select distance_meters / duration_seconds * 3.6 as kilometers_per_hour,
         round(duration_seconds * 1000 / distance_meters)::int as seconds_per_km
  where distance_meters > 0 and duration_seconds > 0
) paced on true
order by period_start desc, samsung_uid
